identity.title: exoALMA. IX. Regularized Maximum Likelihood Imaging of Non-Keplerian Features

paper_type_evidence.quote: The planet-hunting ALMA large program exoALMA observed 15 protoplanetary disks
This paper presents the exoALMA RML images, obtained by maximizing the likelihood of the visibility data given a model image and subject to regularizer penalties.

question.value: Do regularized maximum likelihood (RML) images made with MPoL independently reproduce the non-Keplerian features (NKFs) seen in the fiducial CLEAN exoALMA images, and how should RML hyperparameters be chosen (cross-validation) for velocity-resolved multi-channel data?

evidence.quote: Crucially, in the context of exoALMA, RML images serve as an independent verification of marginal features seen in the fiducial CLEAN images.
best practices for synthesizing RML images of multi-channeled (i.e. velocity-resolved) data remain undefined
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2021.1.01123.L.

claims.hypothesis: RML imaging independently reproduces the NKFs seen in the 12CO J=3-2 CLEAN images
claims.experiment: MPoL RML cubes of 7 exoALMA disks compared channel by channel with fiducial CLEAN cubes
claims.result: All features including the NKFs appear in the RML images of all 7 disks
claims.finding: NKFs are robust features rather than imaging artifacts

evidence.quote: The RML methods independently and consistently reproduce the features seen in the fiducial CLEAN images, including all NKFs.

claims.hypothesis: CV hyperparameters from one channel can be applied to a full cube and across lines and continuum subtraction
claims.experiment: 30 CV tests on LkCa 15 across three lines, with and without continuum subtraction, in 5 channels each
claims.result: Optimal lambdas nearly constant across channels, lines and continuum subtraction, with minor variations that did not change morphology
claims.finding: CV on a single representative channel suffices per source, cutting the computational cost; CV is still recommended once per source

evidence.quote: Using cross-validation (CV) for hyperparameter tuning, we found that the set of hyperparameters which minimized the CV score (corresponding to a model with the highest predictive power) remained stable from channel to channel in a given cube

claims.hypothesis: RML cubes give the same emission surfaces and temperature profiles as CLEAN cubes
claims.experiment: disksurf applied to RML cubes of five disks and compared with CLEAN-cube results
claims.result: Surface morphology consistent but RML surfaces extend farther (sometimes 200 au); RML temperatures systematically lower (about 5 K, varying by radius and disk)
claims.finding: Broad agreement with offsets likely tied to the lower RML noise and sparsity regularization, needing further study

evidence.quote: RML methods generally reproduce the azimuthally averaged emission surfaces and temperature profiles found with CLEAN cubes.

claims.hypothesis: RML imaging improves resolution beyond the CLEAN beam
claims.experiment: Native and 0.05'' and 0.15'' convolved RML cubes compared with 0.15'' CLEAN, with uniform CV-only hyperparameters
claims.result: No clear resolution improvement in all images
claims.finding: Super-resolution would need source-specific tuning not done for this uniform sample

evidence.quote: We do not achieve a clear improvement in resolution in all the images presented here.

why_this_data.value: Seven disks chosen because they show prominent NKFs in 12CO CLEAN images; five from a visual search for kinks plus two with large-scale arcs

evidence.quote: The source selection was motivated by a preliminary visual search for kink-like substructures caused by planets, resulting in an initial sample of five disks

why_this_method.value: Multiple imaging techniques recommended for kinematic planet detection; RML gives an independent check on CLEAN

evidence.quote: Thus, recent recommendations for kinematically detecting planets strongly suggest using multiple image synthesis techniques to image the data

evidence.quote: deviating from the set of hyperparameters which minimize the CV score introduces human bias

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Per-channel CV not adopted because CV is the most computationally expensive part

evidence.quote: The CV process is by far the most computationally expensive component of RML imaging

evidence.quote: we do not take this optional tuning step and use strictly the hyperparameter values which minimized the CV score for each source.
